scene: A Saturday morning session recording, replayed against the catalogue as it stood at 09:00, with nothing being changed underneath any of it. One customer scrolls the whole of Home & Kitchen price low to high, ten products a screen. A second reads the same hundred and twenty products through the sort menu's other setting, most in stock first and cheapest within that, twelve a screen. The storefront asks for its fourth category page, the ten products after the first thirty. Around a third of the hundred and twenty sit at the same promotional price.
